freeze_before: Any market-data access or economic replay of the changed version; neither authorized by this protocol

owner_dispatch.HYB_FAILED_AUCTION_REVERSAL: ICT finite; trend ownership is a separate unresolved grammar
owner_dispatch.HYB_CORRECTIVE_COMPLETION_RESUMPTION: ELLIOTT/count structure; Harmonic location is supporting provenance, not exit dispatcher

source_contract: Initial invalidation, structural pivots, finite goals and owner failures require causal source/owner bindings. No acceptance-bar-low fallback, imagined upside, unsupported ratio family table or independent pivot-bag ownership.

stop_contract.initial_hard_stop: Source-owned invalidation fixed before entry, still live intrabar and on gaps
stop_contract.earned_structure: Strict L0 H0 L1 H1 alternating same-owner sequence; L1 post-entry higher than L0; H1 higher than H0; all events available; completed owner close above H0 and L1
stop_contract.protected_low: Rises to earned L1 only, never declines
stop_contract.hard_stop: max(previous hard stop, previous earned protected low): one proven structural level of breathing room; not a profit-percentage trail
stop_contract.wick: A wick below protected low alone does not exit, unless standing hard safety invalidation is hit
stop_contract.next_contiguous_owner_close_below_protec: Confirmed failure to reclaim; exit next executable open
stop_contract.reclaim: Close at/above protected low cancels suspicion, never lowers protection
stop_contract.confirmation_design: Two ordered observations, first breach then later failure to reclaim. This is a prospective policy choice, not empirically optimal or a doctrine claim.
stop_contract.native_failure: Causally available typed same-owner failure takes precedence; can schedule exit between owner OHLC closes
stop_contract.risk_override: Hard portfolio limits always retain authority, no winner exemption

objectives.trend: Nearest available unreached same-owner structural objective is a checkpoint only, never automatic take-profit; no known higher level is UNKNOWN price-discovery upside, not an invented percent goal
objectives.finite: Nearest actual source-owned obstacle above entry; executable net must cover both fees; objective frozen at entry
objectives.economics: Report planned dollar net reward and reward per initial risk, explicitly not expected-profit forecasts
objectives.minimum_meaningful_reward: UNRESOLVED: no numeric threshold fabricated from exposed 2022/2023

pending_setup: Live-parent graph, expiry, invalidation and consumption are absorbing; context change requires explicit eligibility re-evaluation; no evidence resurrection or old child surviving invalidated live parent

risk.restoration: At legal OPEN, reduce breached asset first; then choose highest stop-risk removed per dollar sold. Same limits and fee-adjusted equity constraints. Capacity-limited restoration fails closed, not hidden.
risk.continuous_rules: Inherited research numerical rules; not historical tick/lot proof

tests: All nine real research-kernel owner dispatches
Wick/pullback versus breach/reclaim versus contiguous failed reclaim
Monotone hard/protected stops and next-bar application
Gap at actual open; hard-stop-before-target collision
Finite executable target economics; no dollar-goal fabrication
Native source exits between owner closes
Capacity-delayed pending exit and risk restoration
